issues.issue: Did the Officer reasonably find the applicant did not show dual intent (intent to leave after studies)?
issues.applicant_position: Dual intent was clearly stated and is no bar; Officer ignored home-country ties and did not explain preferring the negative view.
issues.respondent_position: Selling his law office and a paralegal course not advancing his career show a single intent to immigrate; refusal was reasonable.
issues.result_quote: In these circumstances, the Decision was reasonable.

issues.issue: Did the Officer have to address the applicant's ties to his home country and his lack of ties to Canada?
issues.applicant_position: Officer failed to consider or explain evidence of home ties, savings, condo and business that favoured a positive decision.
issues.result_quote: the Applicant’s lack of ties to Canada and previous travels to other jurisdictions did not require mention in view of the determinative facts.

issues.issue: Was the second application a fresh application or a reconsideration of the first refusal?
issues.applicant_position: No fee was paid for the second application, so it was really a reconsideration of the first refusal.
issues.result_quote: I have concluded that the Decision in this case was made on a fresh second application and not following a reconsideration.

issues.issue: Should the proposed question on fresh application versus reconsideration be certified?
issues.applicant_position: Asked the Court to certify whether a second application made without fee after refusal is fresh or a reconsideration.
issues.result_quote: This question will not be certified because in my view, its outcome cannot be dispositive of this application.
